description: Rate of queries per second that terminated an approximate NNS search early after hitting the ANN timeout.
Rate of distance computations performed during approximate NNS across the content cluster.
Rate of HNSW graph nodes visited during approximate NNS across the content cluster.
Rate of incoming queries per second that perform an approximate nearest-neighbor search.
Average time spent performing approximate NNS, measured only across queries that actually perform it.
Ratio of HNSW graph nodes visited to distances computed during approximate NNS; values above 1.0 indicate the filter-first (Acorn-1) heuristic is active.
Number of buckets currently pending merge across distributors, which rises during data redistribution or node recovery.
Total number of active documents (primary copies) across all document types and content nodes in the cluster.
Total number of ready (searchable) documents across all document types and content nodes in the cluster.
Share of NNS distance computations done via exact (brute-force) search rather than approximate search; high values may indicate the approximate-threshold is set too high.
Rate of distance computations performed during exact (brute-force) NNS across the content cluster.
Average total time (matching plus ranking) spent per query on the content nodes, specific to the NNS/matching pipeline.
Rate of incoming queries per second that do not perform approximate NNS, including queries that fall back to exact search.
Average time spent on the core query matching process, computed as query latency minus query setup time; includes exact NNS.
Rate of incoming queries per second against the content cluster's document matching pipeline (equal to approximate-nns-query-rate plus non-approximate-nns-query-rate).
Average time spent setting up and tearing down queries, including filter computation and approximate NNS overhead.
Average time spent on query setup and teardown excluding approximate NNS time, isolating filter computation and other overhead.
Rate of queries per second terminated early due to hitting the soft timeout, aggregated across rank profiles.
Average utilization of the match thread pool across content nodes.
Total NNS distance computations per second, combining exact and approximate search, as an overall indicator of NNS-related CPU cost.
